import json, pathlib, re
def read(name):
    try:
        return pathlib.Path(name).read_text()
    except OSError:
        return None
out = {p.relative_to('output').as_posix(): p.read_text() for p in pathlib.Path('output').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
staged = {p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.parts[0] not in ('output', 'home', 'tmp') and not any(s.startswith('.') for s in p.parts)}
changed = {name: text for name, text in out.items() if read(name) != text}
changed.update({name: None for name in staged - set(out)})
MARKER = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:#+\s+|[-*+]\s+|\d+[.)]\s+|>\s*)')
BREAK = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:#|[-*+]\s|\d+[.)]\s)')
MASK = re.compile(r'`[^`]*`|"[^"]*"|“[^”]*”|(?<=\])\([^)]*\)')
SENTENCE = re.compile(r'\S.*?(?:[.!?]+(?=\s|$)|$)', re.S)
OPEN = re.compile(r'^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$')
CLOSE = re.compile(r'^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})[ \t]*$')
ITEM = re.compile(r'^ *(?:[-*+]|\d+[.)])[ \t]+(?=\S)')
def unindent(line, column):
    return line[min(column, len(line) - len(line.lstrip(' '))):]
def longest(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    paragraphs = []
    current = ''
    fence = ''
    column = fence_column = 0
    for line in lines[lines.index('---', 1) + 1:]:
        line = re.sub(r'^(?: {0,3}> ?)+', '', line)
        blank = not line.strip()
        if fence:
            closer = CLOSE.match(unindent(line, fence_column))
            if closer and closer[1][0] == fence[0] and len(closer[1]) >= len(fence):
                fence = ''
            continue
        item = ITEM.match(line)
        if item:
            column = item.end()
        elif not blank and len(line) - len(line.lstrip(' ')) < column:
            paragraphs.append(current)
            current = ''
            column = 0
        opener = OPEN.match(unindent(line, column))
        if opener and not (opener[1][0] == '`' and '`' in opener[2]):
            paragraphs.append(current)
            current = ''
            fence = opener[1]
            fence_column = column
            continue
        if blank or line.strip().startswith('|'):
            paragraphs.append(current)
            current = ''
            continue
        if BREAK.match(line):
            paragraphs.append(current)
            current = ''
        current += (' ' if current else '') + MARKER.sub('', line).strip()
    paragraphs.append(current)
    best = 0
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        for hit in SENTENCE.finditer(MASK.sub(lambda m: ' ' * len(m[0]), paragraph)):
            best = max(best, sum(1 for t in hit[0].split() if any(c.isalnum() for c in t)))
    return best
ok = False
try:
    s = changed['skills/release-notes/SKILL.md']
    side = changed['skills/release-notes/agents/openai.yaml']
    section = re.search('^## Skills$(.*?)(?=^## |\\Z)', changed['README.md'], re.M | re.S)
    rows = [row for row in section[1].splitlines() if row.startswith('|') and 'skills/release-notes/SKILL.md' in row and '/release-notes' in row]
    ok = (re.search('^name: release-notes$', s, re.M) is not None
          and re.search('^disable-model-invocation: true$', s, re.M) is not None
          and 'allow_implicit_invocation: false' in side
          and len(rows) == 1 and longest(s) <= 25)
except Exception:
    pass
print(json.dumps({'score': 1 if ok else 0}))
